Communicate simple ideas and opinions in various discussions, collaborative activities and presentations orally to tell about a sports event.
Write a recount text about a sports event with an appropriate structure of organization and linguistic features and present it.

materials.title: Personal Recount Text
materials.content:
## What is a personal recount?

Personal recount text is one type of recount text in addition to factual, autobiographical, biographical, literary, and historical recount. It retells the writer's past experiences with the aim to either inform or to entertain the audience. It often consists of orientation, series of events, and reorientation.

### Structure

| Part | Function | Example from Andi's text |
|---|---|---|
| Orientation | Introduces the event and the writer's relation to it | The sporting event that I would like to talk about was a national club football tournament. |
| Series of events | Retells what happened in time order | The game continued scoreless until half time, then my team scored. |
| Reorientation | Gives the writer's comment or feeling | I consider this match to be interesting because we never know which team is going to win. |

### Language features

- The past tense retells completed events: took place, started, scored, was.
- The first person is used because the writer tells a personal experience: I, my, we.
- Time connectives show the order: when, then, while, in the meantime, finally.
- Action verbs describe what happened: screamed, jumped, scored, passed.
- Adjectives and sensory details help the reader imagine the event.

A recount answers the reader's questions: what happened, when, where, who was involved, and how the writer felt about it.

terms.definition: A text that retells the writer's past experiences in order to inform or entertain the audience.
The opening part that introduces what happened, when, where, and who was involved.
The main part that retells the events in the order they happened.
The closing part that gives a comment, feeling, or conclusion about the experience.
A detail that appeals to the five senses: sight, hearing, smell, touch, and taste.

materials.title: Reading: Watching a Football Match
materials.content:
## Andi's recount

I like football, whether it is played between two international teams or local teams, as long as the teams give their best on the field. The sporting event that I would like to talk about was a national club football tournament in my country that takes place every year.

Anyway, the football match took place about 5 years ago, when two of the best football clubs of my country played against each other in a final match of the national football tournament. The two arch-rival teams had already clashed against each other in the past, and their number of wins was pretty much the same throughout the history of their clash, especially in this tournament. So, essentially, nobody really knew which team was favorite to win the final.

But when the game actually started, all the supporters of both the teams were screaming and encouraging their respective teams as if they were bound to win. As a supporter, I also wanted my team to win at all costs. Anyway, both teams were playing very "rough and tough" football that led to some unwanted "fouls" and some unfortunate "fistfights".

The game continued scoreless up until the half time interval, but as the second half of the game started, the intensity of the game increased. In the meantime, I was getting nervous in the stadium because my team wasn't exactly playing up to our expectations. In fact, my team was lucky to survive a few scoring chances from the opponent team. Then, suddenly, the ball was passed to the main "striker" of my favorite team from nowhere, and a goal was scored by my team, leaving the supporters of my team completely ecstatic and crazy with the feeling of a possible victory. And, in the end, we were indeed the victorious team.

Anyway, I consider this match to be interesting because we never know which team is going to win. Besides, I consider this match exciting also because it attracts supporters from all over my country. Finally, it is also interesting because no other sporting event makes us as emotional as this one.

Adapted from: https://www.ielts-mentor.com/cue-card-sample/629-describe-a-sporting-event-you-attended — Retrieved: February 7, 2022.

materials.title: Writing a Sports Event Recount
materials.content:
## From notes to a recount

Before writing, collect notes about the event. Answer these questions: What sports event did you attend? When was it? Where did you watch it? Who did you watch it with? What happened first, next, and then? How did you feel about the event? What did you see and hear?

### Use your five senses

| Sense | Question to answer | Example detail |
|---|---|---|
| See | What did you see? | The striker scored in the final minutes. |
| Hear | What did you hear? | The supporters were screaming. |
| Smell | What could you smell? | The smell of grilled sausages. |
| Touch | What did you touch or feel? | The stadium seat felt cold. |
| Taste | What did you taste? | The hotdog tasted really good. |

### Peer review checklist

| Aspect | Question |
|---|---|
| Title | Is a title provided? |
| Organisation | Does each paragraph have only one topic? |
| Introduction | Does the first paragraph introduce the sports event? |
| Content | Do the other paragraphs cover location, companion, and sensory details? |
| Word choice | Are vivid adjectives used to draw pictures in the reader's mind? |
| Length | Is the text between 100 and 200 words? |
| Multimodal | Has the text used another mode, for example pictures? |

### Planning a sports event

A sports event proposal needs clear goals, a suitable venue, and a realistic budget. Check the venue's accessibility (parking and public transport), capacity (participants, team, and supporters), and available equipment (toilets, fields, audience space). The budget may come from grants, sponsors, or ticket sales. Present the plan with text, tables, and images.

- Goals: why the event is held, how many participants, and which values are promoted.
- Venue: accessibility, capacity, and equipment.
- Budget: grants, financial support from sponsors, and income from ticket sales.
- Presentation: use charts, graphs, and documents to inform the audience.

nodes.text: Your class plans a football match. A friend suggests inviting 2,000 spectators to the school field, which has no parking area. What do you do?

choices.text: Check the venue's capacity and accessibility before inviting spectators
choices.feedback: Kapasitas dan aksesibilitas harus diperiksa sebelum jumlah penonton ditetapkan.

choices.text: Invite 2,000 people anyway and hope for the best
choices.feedback: Mengabaikan kapasitas dan akses membuat acara berisiko dan tidak nyaman.

choices.text: Cancel the event without checking anything
choices.feedback: Membatalkan tanpa memeriksa menghilangkan peluang acara yang mungkin layak.

nodes.text: The budget is short. What is the best next step?

choices.text: Look for sponsors and plan ticket sales
choices.feedback: Sponsor dan penjualan tiket adalah sumber dana yang disebut dalam perencanaan acara.

choices.text: Remove the equipment and safety items from the plan
choices.feedback: Mengurangi perlengkapan dan keamanan membahayakan peserta dan penonton.

nodes.text: On the day, the field is overcrowded and some spectators stand in the road. What do you do?

choices.text: Limit entry and open an overflow area with clear information
choices.feedback: Tindakan darurat membantu, tetapi masalahnya berasal dari perencanaan kapasitas.

choices.text: Ignore it because the match is more important

nodes.text: The teacher asks why you cancelled. What do you say?

choices.text: Explain that you needed to check capacity, access, and budget first
choices.feedback: Alasan yang jujur dan berbasis perencanaan dapat diterima.

choices.text: Say there was no reason
choices.feedback: Keputusan tanpa alasan tidak dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.

nodes.text: The event plan is realistic: the venue fits the audience and the budget has clear sources.
The plan saves money but risks the safety and comfort of participants and spectators.
The immediate problem is handled, but next time plan capacity before advertising the event.
The event loses trust because safety and planning were ignored.

questions.explanation: Teks menyebut intensitas pertandingan meningkat pada babak kedua.

options.text: Stay quiet during the national anthem

questions.explanation: Tiga perilaku pertama menjaga suasana pertandingan; membuang sampah melanggar etika penonton.

questions.question: Match each word with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Keempat kata kunci ini muncul dalam teks recount olahraga dan dapat ditebak dari konteks.

questions.question: Put the parts of Andi's recount in the correct order.

options.text: The event was a national club football tournament.
The match took place about 5 years ago.
The game continued scoreless until my team scored.
I consider this match interesting and exciting.

questions.explanation: Orientasi → latar pertandingan → rangkaian kejadian → reorientasi.

questions.question: Why does the paragraph "But when the game actually started…" belong to the series of events?

options.text: It retells what happened during the match in time order.
It gives the final comment about the match.
It lists the rules of football.

questions.explanation: Paragraf itu menceritakan kejadian saat pertandingan berlangsung, sehingga termasuk rangkaian peristiwa.

questions.question: What can you infer from "their number of wins was pretty much the same"?

options.text: The final was difficult to predict.
The teams never played each other.

questions.explanation: Kemenangan yang seimbang membuat tidak ada tim yang jelas lebih unggul, sehingga hasil sulit diprediksi.

questions.question: What is the writer's main purpose in the text?

options.text: To retell a memorable sports experience
To persuade readers to play football
To explain the history of football rules
To describe a football player's physical features

questions.explanation: Teks adalah personal recount yang menceritakan pengalaman menonton pertandingan.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the past tense correctly?

options.text: The game continued scoreless until half time.
The game continue scoreless until half time.
The game is continue scoreless yesterday.
The game will continued scoreless last week.

questions.explanation: Recount memakai past tense: continued. Pilihan lain salah bentuk atau mencampur waktu.

questions.question: Which detail appeals to the sense of sight?

options.text: The ball was passed to the main striker.
The air smelled of grilled sausages.

questions.explanation: Melihat bola dioper ke striker adalah pengalaman visual.

questions.question: Why should a recount include sensory details?

options.text: They help readers imagine the experience.
They make the text longer without a purpose.
They replace the need for a structure.

questions.explanation: Detail pancaindra membuat pembaca seolah ikut mengalami peristiwa.

questions.question: Why does the writer put "rough and tough" in quotation marks?

options.text: To highlight the physical style of play
To show that the words are misspelled

questions.explanation: Tanda kutip menyorot gaya bermain yang keras dan fisik, bukan kesalahan ejaan.

questions.question: Which sentence is an orientation rather than an event?

options.text: The sporting event that I would like to talk about was a national club football tournament.
The ball was passed to the main striker.

questions.explanation: Kalimat pertama memperkenalkan peristiwa yang akan diceritakan, jadi termasuk orientasi.

questions.question: Which revision makes "The match was good" more vivid?

options.text: The match was exciting because the score stayed level until the final minutes.
The match was very very good.
The match was good and nice and fun.
The match was better than any other match ever.

questions.explanation: Revisi yang baik menambahkan alasan dan detail konkret, bukan mengulang kata sifat atau opini.

questions.question: Which information is NOT needed in the orientation?

options.text: The final score of the match

questions.explanation: Orientasi memperkenalkan latar; hasil akhir biasanya muncul di rangkaian peristiwa atau reorientasi.

questions.question: Why does the writer mention "about 5 years ago"?

options.text: To set the time of the experience

questions.explanation: Keterangan waktu membantu pembaca mengetahui kapan pengalaman itu terjadi.

questions.question: What can you infer about the writer's loyalty?

options.text: He strongly wanted his team to win.
He did not care about the result.
He wanted the opponent to win.

questions.explanation: Penulis mengatakan ia ingin timnya menang "at all costs" dan gugup saat timnya tertinggal.

questions.question: Which question checks a venue's accessibility?

options.text: Is it easy to reach by public transport and is there enough parking?
What colour is the team jersey?

questions.explanation: Aksesibilitas berkaitan dengan kemudahan mencapai lokasi dan ketersediaan parkir.

questions.question: Which factors should be considered when planning a sports event? Choose all that apply.
questions.explanation: Tujuan, lokasi, dan anggaran adalah faktor utama; kenyamanan penonton justru harus diperhatikan.

questions.question: Arrange the writing process of a sports event recount.
questions.explanation: Catatan → tabel rencana → draft → tinjauan teman → revisi dan publikasi.
